answer_1.quote: We introduce SceneGenAgent, an LLM-based coding agent capable of generating industrial scenes from descriptions, analyzing and improving layout for precise generation... The description is translated into C# code using Tecnomatix API.
answer_1.outputs: C# code for Tecnomatix, 3D scene layout with object placements

answer_2.quote: We adopt the pass@k metric, a commonly used metric for coding performance that measures the ratio of programming problems where at least one out of k generated code samples qualifies.

answer_4.quote: Our evaluation team consists of 3 members with expertise in industrial scenes and proficiency in the Process Simulate software. ... we sample 5 times for each description ... each evaluator reviews at least one of the five samples of each description.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compare each generated scene against its textual description, checking correctness of object placements and adherence to specified constraints.
